en.summary: Planet Zoo 2 is Frontier Developments' sequel to its acclaimed zoo management sim, launching October 13, 2026 on PC, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X/S. The sequel adds two habitat types the original never had — fully aquatic aquariums and flying aviaries — alongside a new conservation layer: once a species is thriving in your zoo, you can release and breed it in open, ecosystem-style Wildlife Reserves outside the park gates.

guideSections.title: Aquariums & Aviaries: New Habitat Types
guideSections.description: How to build custom freshwater and saltwater aquariums with filtration and guest walk-through tunnels, and how aviary mesh-canopy physics and support poles work for flighted birds.

guideSections.title: Wildlife Reserves & Conservation Loop
guideSections.description: How releasing zoo-bred animals into Wildlife Reserves works, how reserve breeding and ecosystem management differ from standard habitat care, and why it matters for long-term conservation scoring.
